problem:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

In terms of ${a}_{ij},$ the highlighted entry of the matrix $A$ corresponds to{{field-1}}.

examples.knowledge_point: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation
examples.problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $C$ given below. Describe it in terms of $c_{ij}.$

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 5 \\ 34 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$
examples.worked_solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $1$st row and $3$rd column. Therefore, we have $c_{13}={\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{5}}.$

feedback.problem:
Find the entry ${a}_{32}$ of the matrix $A$, where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 3 \\ 6 & 2 & 1 \\ 4 & 8 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The entry ${a}_{32}$ lies at the intersection of the $3$rd row and $2$nd column. Therefore, ${a}_{32}=8.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 3 \\ 6 & 2 & 1 \\ 4 & 8 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$
